Section 4: Infection Control & Hygiene Guidelines
Preventing the spread of upper respiratory viruses protects family and
community health. Key Prevention Steps: - Cover coughs and sneezes with a
elbow or tissue. - Wash hands thoroughly with soap and water after
coughing or sneezing. - Avoid close contact with vulnerable individuals
during acute respiratory symptoms.
